name: gitlab-work-items
description: Brings GitLab Issues and Tasks into Claude Code: fetch them and filtered lists live, see their merge requests, and edit, comment, resolve Threads, and create them after previewing every Write.

instance_url.title: GitLab Instance URL
instance_url.description: Base URL of your GitLab Instance, including any sub-path, for example https://gitlab.example.com or https://example.com/gitlab.

token.title: GitLab personal access token (optional)
token.description: A token with the api scope (read_api is enough for reading). Leave empty to use your glab login for this Instance, or GITLAB_TOKEN.

footer.title: Add a "Posted with Claude Code" footer
footer.description: Adds a short footer to Comments, replies, and new Work Items' descriptions.
